about.description: QQQX is an ETF perpetual listed on Kraken, tracking Invesco QQQ Trust, Series 1, margined and cash-settled in USD. Traders get synthetic price exposure only - no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Kraken prices this market off the Backed xStock token for Invesco QQQ Trust, Series 1, a tokenized representation of the listed shares rather than the shares themselves. Funding settles every 1h. Up to 20x leverage. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification.
